skills.description: Richard Feynman's "What Do You Care What Other People Think?" — an executable toolkit that captures Feynman's approach to curiosity, scientific thinking, integrity under pressure, and living a life unconstrained by others' opinions. 一方地域的风骨，在群山分界、江河脉络、道路变迁之中。

行旅踏过城池，问风物几何，只为探寻这片土地的灵魂。
